snippet.title: Beyond R: Rule Ripper - Release Date short trailer
snippet.description:
An indie visual novel inspired by genre classics like Danganronpa, Ever17, Ace Attorney, and Zero Escape. The Owner has kidnapped you, poisoned you, and trapped you in their Golden Jack bar alongside 9 strangers. Go beyond these shackles and defy the death game.

Wishlist now on Steam and check out the demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551380/Beyond_R_Rule_Ripper
